about_the_game:
In this Demo (for the Full Game: On the Way) you dive into a world of twisted minds as you embark on the search for a lost man. You will play the Introduction Level leading up to the Full Games' Plot. (The Demo Part will still be in the full game but is only a fraction of what will await you in the full Release!)

In a classical Survival Horror Fashion in the First Person Perspective you will solve puzzles, will interact with the world and get to explore a handcrafted world! Manage your Inventory with care as you might not carry everything you collect at once. Fight off enemies with Melee and Range weapons you can find on your travels and experience the Stories of a once thriving place.

content_descriptors.notes: It is a classical Psychological Horror Game.
